capture_method: Actual executable in Windows ConPTY; ANSI stream decoded into terminal cells by pyte; cells rendered in headless Chromium.
credentials: No license key supplied; local template; credential-bearing environment variables excluded.

assets.command: crabyard new "Field Notes" --auth none --ui shadcn --author Crabyard --bundle-id com.crabyard.fieldnotes --extras sql,fs,log,window-state --template template --no-git --no-install
assets.presentation: Terminal cells and original colors preserved; blank margin rows trimmed for CLI captures. Window chrome and descriptive captions added outside the terminal.
